release.body:
> [!NOTE] 
> If you are looking for [rolling releases](https://bazel.build/release#rolling-releases), please visit [this page](https://bazel.build/release/rolling).

_**The following release notes are still in the process of being updated and cleaned up.**_

# Release 10.0.0rc3 (2026-11-10)


Release Notes:

Android:
+ Add proper error ordering for bazel mobile-install command (#30998)

CLI:
+ Target counts of 10,000 or more in the "Found" summaries for builds and tests now include comma separators, matching other CLI messages. (#32215)

Configurability:
+ **[Incompatible]** `template_ctx.run` now rejects a template's own output directories passed through `tools`, as it already did for `inputs`. Pass individual files produced by sibling actions instead. (#31029)
+ **[Incompatible]** Bazel no longer trims the lines of the `unused_inputs_list` file before matching them against the action's inputs as file names may begin or end with whitespace. (#31533)
+ Platforms whose names contain `/` no longer fail analysis when used in output directory names. (#31707)
+ The new `--inject_module={module name}={path}` flag adds a module from a local path as a dependency of the root module, without editing `MODULE.bazel`. (#32009)

Core:
+ Fixed a crash with `--keep_going` when the scope of a `genquery` depends on a failing module extension. (#31818)
+ Fix a crash when input pruning and remote action rewinding interact with runfiles trees. (#32091)

ExternalDeps:
+ `bazel fetch --force` no longer causes the fetched repos to be fetched again by the next build with a spurious warning about external modifications. (#31108)
+ Added Label.repo_root as a replacement for the deprecated Label.workspace_root. (#31173)
+ `bazel mod show_repo` now prints the path of each repo's directory as a `# Located at:` comment in text output and as the new `repo_root` field in proto and JSON output. (#31176)
+ **[Incompatible]** `bazel mod tidy` now evaluates all module extensions in the dependency graph to update the lockfile, including extensions used only by dependencies. It can thus be used as a full replacement for `bazel mod deps` when the goal is to ensure that the lockfile is up-to-date. When using `bazel vendor`, this may require vendoring additional dependencies. (#31329)
+ `bazel vendor --lockfile_deps` additionally vendors the repositories required to update the lockfile, e.g. with `bazel mod tidy`, while fetching is disabled, which can be combined with target patterns. The `@bazel_tools//tools:tools_for_bazel_subcommands` filegroup is deprecated. (#31562)
+ **[Incompatible]** `bazel_dep()` no longer accepts dependencies on the current module, which serve no purpose and were never intended to be allowed. Remove self-dependencies and use the module's own repository name for self-references. (#31552)
+ **[Incompatible]** The root module can no longer use `use_repo()` to import an extension repository that it overrides with the root module itself (using `override_repo()` or `inject_repo()`). Remove the self-import and use the root module's existing repository name. Other modules can still import the overridden repository. (#31553)
+ Added `--watch_registry` for local registries. If set, bazel watches these registries for changes, and invalidates the bzlmod local cache. (#31945)
+ **[Incompatible]** The `files` of `http_archive` and `archive_override` are now copied instead of symlinked, which allows the repo contents cache to store these repos. The `symlink_files` method in `@bazel_tools//tools/build_defs/repo:utils.bzl` has been removed. (#32217)

General:
+ The deprecated `remote_execution_properties` platform attribute has been removed in favor of `exec_properties`.
+ The new `attr.label_list_dict` type accepts a dict in which keys are strings and values are lists of labels.
+ The new `--remote_max_concurrency_per_connection` can be used to specify the maximum number of concurrent gRPC requests Bazel will issue on a single connection to the server. The default value of 100 matches the previous behavior.
+ bazel query/cquery/aquery now supports an `executables()` function to find only the executable targets in a given expression
+ In environment variable values set via `--repo_env`, the substring `%bazel_workspace%` is now replaced with the absolute path of the current Bazel workspace. This can, for example, be used to make tools checked into the repository available on the `PATH` for repository rules.
+ Added an optional parameter to allow eliding the stack trace when calling fail().
+ `--override_repository` now supports apparent repository names from the point of view of the main repository. An unknown apparent repo name will result in an error.
+ The values of keyword arguments passed to `use_repo` can now contain the special substrings `{name}` and `{version}`, which are treated as equivalent to the corresponding attributes of the current module.
+ C static libraries can now elide backwards reference warnings (if linking with LLD and such warnings are enabled) if the `warn_backrefs_defined` feature is defined and enabled for the toolchain.
+ The new `package_relative_label` function on the rule context (`ctx`) can be used to turn a user-provided label string into a `Label` relative to the target that is currently being analyzed (where `Label(...)` would return a `Label` relative to the `.bzl` file containing the call).
+ Reporting of cached test results can now be suppressed with `--test_summary=short_uncached` or `--test_summary=detailed_uncached`.
+ **[Incompatible]** The `config_setting`s `@bazel_tools//src/conditions:{host_windows,remote}` have been removed. Toolchains are usually a better fit as they don't depend on the configuration of the host machine running Bazel and/or fixed execution modes.
+ Bazel now fails over immediately to mirror URLs if a TLS handshake error occurs.
+ Labels in the main repo will now have a `repr` form that reliably evaluates back to themselves (that is, `repr(Label("@@//:foo")) == "Label(\"@@//:foo\")"`).
+ The `compatibility_level` and `max_compatibility_level` attributes of `module` in MODULE.bazel are now no-ops. Module maintainers should stop specifying those attributes and provide clear build time error messages and actionable migration paths when making major breaking changes.
+ **[Incompatible]** The environment variable `LC_CTYPE` now defaults to `C.UTF-8` for actions that set `use_default_shell_env = True`, which results in a Unicode-aware locale on essentially all non-EOL Linux distributions, with MSYS2 as well as macOS 15.4 and higher. Pass `--action_env==LC_CTYPE` (note the two `=`s) to explicitly unset this variable, which restores the previous behavior. On older versions of macOS, you can set `--action_env=LC_CTYPE=UTF-8` instead.
+ The `requires-worker-protocol` execution requirement is now forwarded to remote execution services as a platform property (`persistentWorkerProtocol`) to support intermixing JSON and Proto remote persistent worker protocols across a build.
+ `rctx.symlink` now implicitly watches the target if it falls back to a copy.
+ Fix --lockfile_mode=error validation when rolling back changes to module extension facts
+ `package_group` now supports labels with external repositories in the `packages` attribute.
+ **[Incompatible]** `--incompatible_check_testonly_for_output_files` has been flipped. See https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/issues/28875 for more details.
+ **[Incompatible]** string.splitlines() no longer incorrectly treats u+0085 (NEL) as a newline character
+ Bazel no longer verifies the digests of disk cache entries upon a cache hit. This honors the description but not the previous behavior of the `--remote_verify_downloads` flag, which in fact controlled digest verification for both remote and disk caches.
+ Bazel now has experimental support for --rewind_lost_inputs, which can rerun actions within a single build to recover from (remote or disk) cache evictions.
+ BEP events will now be written respecting parent-child ordering constraints.
+ Added `--experimental_remote_cache_chunking` flag to read and write large blobs to/from the remote cache in chunks. Requires server support.
+ Bzlmod now enforces that integrity strings for patches and overlay files in `source.json` are non-empty.
+ A `.bazelrc` file may now only `import` files recursively with a depth of up to 512 imports. If you see a "Maximum import depth exceeded parsing config file" error message, check that your workspace genuinely needs to be configured with `.bazelrc` files loading other rc files in a chain as long as 512 files. If you are configured in this way and cannot easily change your `.bazelrc` files to use shorter `import` chains, you may set the `BAZEL_UNLIMITED_IMPORT_DEPTH` environment variable to any value to disable this limit.
+ Module extension tags now have an implicit `_sort_key` field that can be compared to derive the order in which tags from different classes appear in the MODULE.bazel file.
+ The remote repo contents cache now supports all reproducible repo rules.
+ `--disk_cache` can now be set without an argument to enable the disk cache using a default location at `<outputUserRoot>/cache/disk`. Other boolean forms (`--disk_cache=1` or `--disk_cache=true` to enable; `--disk_cache=0`, `--disk_cache=false` or `--nodisk_cache` to disable) are also accepted.
+ Adds `--output:display_full_kind` for query options to display the full kind for Starlark rules with the `label_kind`, `location`, and `xml` output formats.
+ Changes the `debugPrint` of `ctx.download` to include the state of the download. Adds an `error` key to the returned struct when `success: false` to explain why it's false.
+ The local and remote repo contents cache now include the host OS and CPU architecture in the cache key.
+ Fix launcher/launcher_maker for cross build, e.g. build windows binary on linux machine.
+ The flag `--fdo_optimize` now accepts repo labels as well as package labels.
+ **[Incompatible]** Add support for `startup:linux`, `startup:macos`, etc bazelrc options.
+ Adds `-Djava.net.preferIPv6Addresses=system` to startup JVM args which may impact certain IPv4-only environments. Override as necessary with `--host_jvm_args`.
+ **[Incompatible]** Add support for decompressing Brotli archives (.br, .tar.br)
+ bazelrc config declarations can now be empty
+ **[Incompatible]** Removes the deprecated repository rule `new_git_repository`. Users should use `git_repository` instead (they are the same)
+ **[Incompatible]** Remove `/usr/local/bin` from default `PATH`. Set `--action_env` and `--host_action_env` to `/bin:/usr/bin:/usr/local/bin` if needed.
+ Added SOCKS proxy support. Bazel now accepts `socks://`, `socks4://`, and `socks5://` URLs in `HTTPS_PROXY`/`HTTP_PROXY` environment variables and related system properties.
+ None
+ Large numbers with 5+ digits in CLI output are now formatted with comma separators for improved readability (e.g., "12,345 targets configured" instead of "12345 targets configured")
+ Added the `module_ctx.tag_sort_key(tag)` method, which returns an opaque object for the given tag that can be compared to derive the order in which tags from different classes appear in the MODULE.bazel file.
+ Adds the `strip_components` attribute to `extract`/`download_and_extract`/`http_archive` to allow stripping of path components when extracting files.
+ **[Incompatible]** `exec_properties` now respects `resources:cpu` and `resources:memory` for local resource estimation.
+ Add `add_prefix` attribute to `git_repository` to allow cloning repositories into a given subdirectory prefix
+ {r,m}ctx.download* report the size of downloaded files Addition to the user-facing Build API
+ `--tls_certificate=`, `--tls_client_certificate=`, and `--tls_client_key=` can now be used to reset those flags to their unset state.
+ In output of `query --output=build`, string attributes containing newline characters are now enclosed in triple double quotes (""") for better readability.
+ CDC chunk uploads and downloads can now happen in parallel within a large blob.
+ Addition to the user-facing Build API
+ Enabled output path mapping (config stripping) support for `ArchivedTreeArtifact`s to improve action caching under `--experimental_output_paths=strip`.
+ `module_extension(...)` now accepts a `facts_version` integer parameter. Bumping it invalidates the facts persisted in `MODULE.bazel.lock` for that extension, allowing extension authors to make breaking changes to the facts schema without risking misinterpretation by older code paths.
+ Add an `exclude` param to `rtx.watch_tree()` to allow excluding glob patterns from watch.
+ Fixed an issue that caused Bazel to fail on a lost input even with build or action rewinding enabled.
+ BuildFinished events in BEP will consistently contain an "infrastructure-caused" detailed exit code when a single target contains both infrastructure-caused and user-caused exit codes in its failed actions.
+ The new `refines_constraint_value` attribute on `constraint_setting` can be used to indicate that any non-default value for that setting specified on a `platform` requires the refined value to also be specified.
+ Bazel's serialization system now has a new wire encoding that supports preserving how values are serialized across Bazel versions.
+ Fixed repo content caching for non-gRPC cache backends.
+ CCStarlarkInternal exposes hash functions currently  used by rules_cc Java rules to starlark
+ The new `--expand_param_files` flag expands param files into their contents in `--subcommands` and `--verbose_failures` output.
+ Fixed a performance regression in Bazel 9 that causes `RepoMappingManifest` actions to consume a lot of CPU time.
+ Improved BES upload failure message with failed invocation's ID.
+ Any existing action relying on the legacy hardcoded list in Bazel code being populated will now need to opt-into output mapping by modifying their execution requirements.
+ Bazel no longer limits the size of gRPC messages received from the remote executor or cache.
+ The `and_then` method on `transition`s can be used to compose transitions. Both Starlark transitions and native transitions (e.g. `config.exec()`) are supported.
+ External repos are no longer refetched whenever they contribute inputs to an action using the hermetic Linux sandbox.
+ Enable TCP keepalive by default for gRPC connections with reasonable defaults
+ Remove CoptsFilter. rules_cc 0.2.19 no longer uses it..
+ The remote repo contents cache now correctly materializes chains of symlinks as action inputs, but no longer supports symlinks into the main repository.
+ Fixed Bazel being unable to run a Windows executable whose path is too long to shorten under `MAX_PATH`, e.g. when 8dot3 short names are disabled (microsoft/Windows-Containers#507).
+ Fixed spurious "No such file" errors with the remote repo contents cache when a repo contains a symlink to a `.bzl` file.
+ Source directories in external repositories are temporarily allowed to cross package boundaries. This will be disallowed in the future, gated by the new `--incompatible_check_external_repo_source_dir_package_boundary` flag.
+ Adds `bazel dump --skyframe=keys` to report only the keys available in SkyFrame. Always use with `--skykey_filter` to limit the number of keys reported.
+ Fixed a crash with `--experimental_remote_repo_contents_cache` when running without a remote or disk cache.
+ **[Incompatible]** Custom Starlark rules named `test_suite` are no longer treated as a `test_suite`
+ Fix --progress_in_terminal_title output under screen and emacs.
+ Modifying environment variables no longer causes spurious reloading of packages in external repositories.
+ Fixed a spurious remote-execution failure with `--experimental_output_paths=strip` where a lost input in a tree artifact shared between actions could not be recovered by action rewinding.
+ Windows launcher stubs now embed an `asInvoker` UAC manifest, preventing "The requested operation requires elevation. (error: 740)" for targets whose name matches the installer-detection heuristic.
+ Fixed a flaky crash when Java compilation actions encounter multiple lost `.jdeps` files.
+ The remote repo contents cache no longer caches or restores repos with cross-repo symlinks, thus avoiding a large surface area for bugs. The effort to reenable this support is tracked by https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/issues/30160.
+ `--worker_sandboxing` can now be scoped per worker-key mnemonic with `--worker_sandboxing=<mnemonic>=<boolean>`.
+ If --incompatible_symbolic_macro_strict_attrs is enabled, invalid attribute values in symbolic macros fail the build (matching the behavior of rules).
+ **[Incompatible]** in min() and max(), the key callback is now prohibited from mutating the sequence being iterated over
+ Added a new `instance_id` field to the `BuildMetrics` BES event, in order to help diff between the current and previous builds on the running server.
+ `--experimental_remote_scrubbing_config=` now disables remote cache key scrubbing, allowing command-line overrides of scrubbing configs set in .bazelrc.
+ "$ bazel config x86-opt": you can now inspect configs based on output path prefixes, not just config checksum prefixes.
+ The JDK bundled with Bazel has been updated to 26.
+ Action rewinding (`--rewind_lost_inputs`) can now succeed even if the remote cache doesn't verify that AC entries aren't stale.
+ **[Incompatible]** `--test_tmpdir=` now resets a value from a bazelrc to the default execroot temp directory instead of creating `_tmp` in the workspace. Use `--test_tmpdir=.` to retain workspace-relative behavior.
+ Running `bazel shutdown` no longer results in stale lockfile data being written.
+ Starlark debug server now binds to the configured address (defaulting to 127.0.0.1) via --experimental_skylark_debug_server_address.
+ **[Incompatible]** Bind mounts specified via `--sandbox_add_mount_pair` (or `-M`/`-m` flags in `linux-sandbox`) are now correctly remounted read-only when using the hermetic sandbox (with `--experimental_sandbox_hermetic`). Build actions that write to these paths will now fail with a read-only filesystem error.
+ **[Incompatible]** `--use_target_platform_for_tests` is now a no-op. By default, tests are executed on an execution platform that has all constraints of the target platform, making this flag obsolete. To migrate, make sure that your target platform or a platform with at least the same constraints is registered as an execution platform.
+ Fixes an error when using `strip_components` with archives containing symbolic//hard links.
+ Fixed `repository_ctx.download_and_extract` failing with an "Expected a file with a ... suffix" error when `--downloader_config` blocks all URLs and the archive is served from the repository cache.
+ `--incompatible_modify_execution_info_additive` is now deprecated and a no-op. When `--modify_execution_info` is specified multiple times, all values are always applied in order.
+ Added `--experimental_remote_cache_chunking_function` to select the content-defined chunking function used by `--experimental_remote_cache_chunking`. Supported values are `auto` (the default, which negotiates the function from the server capabilities, preferring FastCDC 2020), `fast_cdc_2020` and `rep_max_cdc`.
+ --experimental_split_coverage_processing and --experimental_fetch_all_coverage_outputs default to true.
+ Retry 408 and 429 status codes with HTTP remote caching.
+ Fixed a bug that could cause `ignore_directories()` to not ignore directories.
+ **[Incompatible]** The Windows shell launcher now again prepends rather than appends the directory containing the shell binary, restoring the behavior of Bazel 8.x. This is technically an incompatible change, but deemed necessary due to the unexpected and widespread implications of the change in 9.0.0. See https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/issues/29637 for more context.
+ The `BAZEL_LLVM_PROFILE_FILE` environment variable can now be used to customize the LLVM profile filename pattern for C++ coverage collection (e.g. `--test_env=BAZEL_LLVM_PROFILE_FILE=%p.profraw`). Defaults to `%h-%p-%m.profraw` when unset.
+ Honor XDG_CACHE_HOME on Windows in Bazel.
+ Fix `sh_binary` on Windows to pass user arguments as positional parameters to bash instead of concatenating them.
+ Fixes a possible crash on Windows Arm64 related to JNI strings
+ Added urlencode($1) support to --downloader_config rewrite rules.
+ Fix `Could not chdir` in `tw.exe` for long runfiles paths on Windows.
+ `--server_javabase` and nojdk builds of Bazel can now use JREs in addition to JDKs.
+ With the new `--experimental_keep_change_prunable_nodes_during_gc` flag, Skyframe will keep computed nodes that aren't requested by the current evaluation but whose dependencies would be verified clean after change pruning.
+ Test targets can now be built for a target platform that no execution platform is compatible with, e.g. to cross-compile them. Running such a test fails with an error at execution time instead of failing analysis.
+ **[Incompatible]** `--rewind_lost_inputs` is now enabled by default. Builds with BwoB automatically recover from remote cache eviction by rewinding actions that generated lost inputs.
+ Cycles between `MODULE.bazel` files connected via `include()` are now reported as an error instead of hanging the build.
+ Fixed a crash while evaluating `MODULE.bazel` files when Skyframe dropped its temporary state in response to memory pressure.
+ Fixed a build failure with `--execution_log_compact_file` when a C++ action template has no inputs.
+ Files uploaded to the disk cache are now copied with a copy-on-write clone where the filesystem supports it, so a cache entry can share its blocks with the output it was uploaded from.
+ Module extensions are now correctly rerun when the root module changes the `dev_dependency` value of a `use_extension` call, which is visible to extensions as `module_ctx.root_module_has_non_dev_dependency`.
+ The C++ include scanner now properly resolves headers that are generated at build time and included as part of the toolchain.
+ Starlark `fail()` calls now format error messages with `Error: ` instead of `Error in fail: `. Resolves https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/issues/21523.
+ Aquery now supports the `config(expr, word)` function.
+ Fixed unnecessary remote-cache hits in incremental BwoB builds after a previous invocation used a broader remote output download policy.
+ Fix an issue on Windows where empty environment variables (e.g. `--action_env=VAR=`) caused test execution failures in the test wrapper.
+ `--experimental_override_platform_cpu_name` renamed to `--override_platform_cpu_name`
+ The macOS sandbox now allows actions to bind sockets when network access is blocked, matching the behavior of the Linux sandbox. Note that macOS cannot restrict inbound connections by peer, so an action that listens on a non-loopback address is reachable from other hosts on the network; outbound traffic remains restricted to loopback.
+ Clean up unused stashed sandbox directories when shutting down the Bazel server.
+ Downloader rewrites to endpoints that refuse connections no longer repeat the connector's full retry sequence.
+ Fix `grep: invalid option -- P` errors on macOS when running release and documentation scripts.
+ Remote execution, remote caching, and auth flags can now be reset to their default unset state on the command line by passing an empty value (e.g., `--remote_cache=`, `--remote_executor=`, `--google_credentials=`).
+ Invalidate cached action execution results when remote cache/executor endpoints or `--remote_instance_name` change between invocations.
+ Fix issue where `bazel test --nobuild` failed with `TEST_WITH_NOANALYZE` instead of succeeding after analysis.
+ With Build without the Bytes, a requested top-level output that was deleted locally is now reliably redownloaded in the next build that requests it, even if other invocations ran in between.
+ Avoid redundant remote CAS uploads when using combined disk and remote caching with a cold disk cache.
+ Fix incremental remote builds failing to create output directories beneath stale dangling symlinks.
+ credential-helper: treat `null` values in response as unset.
+ Fixed a rare crash with `NullPointerException` in `ActionInputMap.getIndex` when an action discovers additional inputs while executing.
+ Add `repository_ctx.patch(directory)`
+ Disk cache entries deleted by a concurrent garbage collection are now treated as cache misses and don't result in failures.
+ Fix an issue where Java compilation actions re-execute on every build due to an Action Cache digest mismatch when `--experimental_output_paths=strip` and in-memory `.jdeps` files are enabled.
+ Credential helper failures now abort HTTP downloads instead of continuing without authentication.
+ Support `dict(label, string)` aspect attributes in `query --output=proto`.
+ **[Incompatible]** --experimental_sibling_repository_layout is now a no-op.
+ Transitive rule and toolchain resolution errors are now formatted into a multi-line indented hierarchy. Fixes https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/issues/15791
+ Fix NullPointerException and improve error messages when Starlark implicit output templates reference unset or unknown attributes.
+ `DefaultInfo.executable` exposes the executable of configured targets and directly constructed providers, including providers returned by `ctx.super()`.
+ Skip implicit output generation when mandatory rule attributes are missing to prevent secondary error messages.
+ Fix crash when evaluating target patterns or paths containing invalid characters or wildcards on Windows.
+ Facts of reproducible module extensions are now restored to the expected state after external modifications by every Bazel command that updates the lockfile.
+ Fix for regression in #29284 that caused select builtin actions to incorrectly inherit resource set overrides.
+ The `--disk_cache_gc_idle_delay`, `--disk_cache_gc_max_size` and `--disk_cache_gc_max_age` flags are no longer experimental.
+ Add `--target_query` / `--target_query_file` flags for building the result of a bazel query in a single command
+ The `--install_base_gc_max_age` flag is no longer experimental.
+ Ensure test processes receive the full `--local_termination_grace_seconds` period to handle `SIGTERM` and perform cleanup on timeout.
+ Windows parameter files now preserve empty arguments and correctly escape backslashes before quotes and at the end of quoted arguments. (#31204)
+ The self-extracting installer now correctly creates installation directories when custom paths contain spaces. (#31226)
+ Fix an O(N^2 log N) analysis phase performance regression when parsing large numbers of Starlark flags.
+ The `--action_cache_gc_idle_delay`, `--action_cache_gc_threshold` and `--action_cache_gc_max_age` flags are no longer experimental.
+ `read_user_netrc` in `@bazel_tools//tools/build_defs/repo:utils.bzl` now honors the `NETRC` environment variable, as the `http_*` repository rules already do. (#31378)
+ Fix `bazel run --run_under=... --script_path=...` on Windows to correctly escape batch script invocations and forward arguments.
+ `bazel dump --skyframe=changed` lists the Skyframe values that the last command created or changed, together with the changed dependencies that caused each change.
+ On Windows, the end of a test's output is no longer sometimes missing from its test log and `test.xml`. (#32382)

Local-Exec:
+ Sandboxed actions no longer fail with "File exists" when an input is nested under a source directory input. (#31206)
+ Fix a crash when first-build sandbox cleanup falls back to synchronous deletion, such as on overlayfs in containers. (#32005)
+ `--experimental_use_hermetic_linux_sandbox` now fails the build on Linux when `linux-sandbox` is not supported, instead of silently falling back to `processwrapper-sandbox`; making it consistent with experimental_use_windows_sandbox. (#32198)

OSS:
+ Allows Batchfiles ran by CreateProcessW in tw.exe to work under longpathAware. (#30490)
+ Add implicit (MODULE.tools) dep on rules_android v0.8.0. (#31425)
+ Removed distrusted eMudhra and Sectigo AAA root CA certificates from the bundled JDK, to address the private key leakage (see https://emudhra.we-have-a-problem.com/). (#31925)

+ `bazel query --output=streamed_proto` can opt into parallel serialization with `--experimental_parallel_streamed_proto_output`. (#30959)

issue.body:
Bazel 9 support for the dependencies of opentelemetry-cpp 1.19.0. Only `bazel_dep` versions change.

- prometheus-cpp 1.3.0.bcr.4: civetweb 1.16.bcr.1 -> 1.16.bcr.4, curl 8.7.1 -> 8.11.0.bcr.2. These versions load `rules_cc`. The presubmit now uses Bazel 7.x, 8.x and 9.x, because curl 8.11.0.bcr.2 needs Bazel 7.2.1 or later. It also uses Debian 11 and Ubuntu 22.04 instead of Debian 10 and Ubuntu 20.04: the newer boringssl from curl does not compile with the GCC on Debian 10.
- opentelemetry-cpp 1.19.0.bcr.2: prometheus-cpp 1.3.0 -> 1.3.0.bcr.4, curl 8.8.0 -> 8.11.0.bcr.2, nlohmann_json 3.11.3 -> 3.12.0.bcr.1.

With these versions, grpc does not have to pin these indirect dependencies to build with Bazel 9 (grpc/grpc#43889). I tested grpc with these versions in a local registry on Bazel 8.x and 9.x.

The source URL of opentelemetry-cpp is the same as in 1.19.0.bcr.1, so I added the `skip-url-stability-check` label.

issue.body:
Bazel 9 support for riegeli and fuzztest.

**riegeli 0.0.0-20261106-1290c60**: new snapshot from upstream HEAD (google/riegeli@1290c60, 2026-11-06), as suggested by the maintainer. Upstream already depends on versions that work with Bazel 9 (for example brotli 1.2.0.bcr.3, xz 5.4.5.bcr.8, google_cloud_cpp 3.12.0). The only change is the `version` in `MODULE.bazel`.
- Presubmit: Bazel 8.x and 9.x on Debian 11 and Ubuntu 22.04. All targets, including `riegeli/gcs`, are in the same task.
- Bazel 7.x is removed: Bazel 7 enforces `compatibility_level`, and abseil-cpp 20260817.0 (requested by riegeli) has a different `compatibility_level` than the abseil-cpp version that protobuf 35.1 requests.

**fuzztest 20260629.0.bcr.1**: only `bazel_dep` versions change.
- flatbuffers 25.12.19 -> 25.12.19.bcr.1 (25.12.19 needs aspect_rules_esbuild 0.21.0, which does not load with Bazel 9).
- riegeli -> 0.0.0-20261106-1290c60.
- Presubmit: add Bazel 9.x, and use Ubuntu 22.04 instead of Ubuntu 20.04 (the clang on Ubuntu 20.04 cannot compile abseil-cpp 20260817.0). Add `--repo_env=CC=clang` and `--repo_env=CXX=clang++`, because Bazel 9 does not pass `--action_env` to the C++ toolchain configuration. Add `-fsized-deallocation`, because riegeli uses sized `operator delete`, which clang enables by default only since clang 19 (Ubuntu 22.04 has an older clang).

I ran all presubmit targets locally on Linux with Bazel 8.x and 9.x. I also built grpc (grpc/grpc#43889) against these versions with Bazel 8.x and 9.x. With them, grpc does not have to pin these indirect dependencies.

The riegeli source URL is a GitHub archive URL, like the previous riegeli versions, so this PR has the `skip-url-stability-check` label.

      future release.
      See https://github.com/bazel-contrib/rules_python/issues/2945

      Ensure all __init__.py files are explicitly created and

      Or for a specific target by setting:

    WARNING: Target @@glib+//gio/gdbus-2.0/codegen:gdbus_codegen is using implicit __init__.py creation.
      This diabolic behavior is deprecated and will be disabled by default in a

## 📋 Gemini BCR Review Summary

**Verdict:** Ready for BCR maintainer review; `presubmit.yml` changes are safe for `presubmit-auto-run`, with one advisory note on `mujoco@4.0.0`'s upstream `MODULE.bazel` for downstream `rules_python` consumers.

**Why manual review is needed:**
- `presubmit.yml` in `mujoco@3.16.0`, `mujoco@3.17.0`, and `mujoco@4.0.0` differs from version `3.15.0` on `main` beyond `matrix.platform`/`matrix.bazel` (requires review before applying `presubmit-auto-run`). Specifically, the `-//test/sample/...` test exclusion in `bcr_test_module.tasks.run_upstream_tests` was removed so that `//test/sample/...` is now also tested in CI.

**Key findings:**
- 🟡 **`modules/mujoco/4.0.0/MODULE.bazel`:** As noted in the PR description, `4.0.0` keeps upstream `MODULE.bazel` verbatim, which calls non-dev `pip.parse(..., python_version = "3.15")` while `python.toolchain(python_version = "3.15")` is under `dev_dependency = True` (and also sets `rules_python_config.explicit_init_py(default = True)` without `dev_dependency = True`). Any downstream module that evaluates the `@rules_python//python/extensions:pip.bzl` extension will fail with `Unable to find interpreter for pip hub 'mujoco_pip' for python_version=3.15` unless it explicitly registers a Python 3.15 toolchain.

<details>
<summary>BCR Playbook Checklist & Version Comparison</summary>

| Check | Status | Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Add-only policy | ✅ | Only adds `3.16.0`, `3.17.0`, and `4.0.0` and appends them to `metadata.json`. No existing versions mutated. |
| Required files, `metadata.json` & maintainership | ✅ | `MODULE.bazel`, `source.json`, and `presubmit.yml` present for all three versions. Author (`@wep21`) is an existing module maintainer with `github_user_id` set. |
| Module naming (new modules) | N/A | Existing module (`mujoco`). |
| `MODULE.bazel`, overlays & C++ `BUILD` targets/visibility | ⚠️ | Upstream archives starting at `3.16.0` include native Bazel build files (`MODULE.bazel`, `REPO.bazel`, `BUILD.bazel`), removing the need for the `3.15.0` overlay and patches. Public target `@mujoco` (`@mujoco//:mujoco`), `@mujoco//:mujoco_renderer`, and `@mujoco//:simulate` are exposed. In `4.0.0`, upstream's non-dev `pip.parse` includes Python `3.15` while `python.toolchain` is dev-only. |
| `presubmit.yml` & `presubmit-auto-run` readiness | ✅ | Identical to `3.15.0` except for expanding `bcr_test_module` test coverage by dropping `-//test/sample/...`. Includes Bazel `8.x`, `9.x`, and `rolling`. Safe to apply `presubmit-auto-run`. |

</details>

Add `mujoco@3.16.0`, `mujoco@3.17.0` and `mujoco@4.0.0`.

Starting with 3.16.0, the upstream release archives ship their own Bazel build
(`MODULE.bazel`, `REPO.bazel` and `BUILD.bazel` files), so these versions use
the upstream definitions as-is:

- `MODULE.bazel` is copied verbatim from each release archive, except that
  3.16.0 declares `bazel_compatibility = [">=8.0.0"]` with the same comment
  upstream uses from 3.17.0 onwards: its `REPO.bazel` already uses
  `ignore_directories()`, which was added in Bazel 8.0, but the release still
  declared `>=7.2.1`. Bazel resolves from the registry copy, so the archive's
  `MODULE.bazel` is not overlaid.
- `source.json` has no overlay and no patches. The include and runfiles fixes
  carried as patches for 3.15.0 are already part of these releases.
- `presubmit.yml` keeps the 3.15.0 layout: the library on all platforms, the
  renderer and `simulate` on Linux and macOS, and upstream `//test/...` run from
  the source root with its dev dependencies. `//test/sample/...` is no longer
  excluded because it passes without changes.

The release assets are prebuilt binaries only, so the source URL is the tag
archive.

### Known issue in 4.0.0 (upstream `MODULE.bazel`, kept as-is)

The 4.0.0 `MODULE.bazel` declares a non-dev `pip.parse` (hub `mujoco_pip`) for
Python 3.11 to 3.15, while its `python.toolchain` calls are dev-only. If a
downstream module also uses the rules_python `pip` extension, mujoco's tags
are evaluated too. Host interpreters for 3.10 to 3.14 happen to be registered
by `pybind11_bazel@3.0.3`, but nothing registers 3.15, so with rules_python
2.4.x this fails with:

```
Unable to find interpreter for pip hub 'mujoco_pip' for python_version=3.15
```

bazel-contrib/rules_python#4184 makes `pip.parse` skip a version that has no
host interpreter. It is in rules_python 2.5.0 (checked with 2.5.0-rc4, which
builds the same consumer cleanly) but not in 2.4.x. Until a consumer resolves
rules_python 2.5.0, adding `python.toolchain(python_version = "3.15")` to the
root module works around it. C++-only consumers are not affected, and 3.17.0
(Python 3.10 to 3.14) is not affected.

### Validation (Linux x86_64, GCC 13)

- Consumer build of `@mujoco//:mujoco`, `@mujoco//:mujoco_renderer` and
  `@mujoco//:simulate`: 3.16.0 and 3.17.0 on Bazel 8.x; 4.0.0 on Bazel 8.x,
  9.x and rolling.
- Upstream `//test/...` from the source root: 3.16.0 (70/70) on Bazel 8.x and
  rolling; 3.17.0 (73/73) on Bazel 8.x, 9.x and rolling; 4.0.0 (73/73) on
  Bazel 8.x, 9.x and rolling.

  presubmit change needs BCR maintainer review.

issue.title: c-ares@1.19.1.bcr.2: declare include/ares_build.h
issue.body:
The c-ares 1.19.1 overlay copies `configs/ares_build.h` to `ares_build.h` at the repo root and declares that copy in `hdrs`. But `include/ares.h` does `#include "ares_build.h"`, and a quoted include resolves first to the directory of the including file, so the compiler picks up the tarball's own `include/ares_build.h`, which isn't in `hdrs`.

You can see this in the compiler's dependency output for any c-ares object: `external/c-ares+/include/ares_build.h` is listed, not the root-level copy. In a normal sandboxed build Bazel doesn't flag it. In a remote-execution setup where the whole source tree reaches the executor, Bazel's header check rejects it with "undeclared inclusion(s) in rule '@c-ares//:ares'".

This version adds `include/ares_build.h` to `hdrs` and is otherwise identical to 1.19.1.bcr.1. grpc still depends on c-ares 1.19.1, so the fix matters for current grpc users.

Testing:
- `bazel run //tools:update_integrity -- c-ares --version=1.19.1.bcr.2` regenerated the overlay hashes in `source.json`.
- `bazel run //tools:bcr_validation -- --check=c-ares@1.19.1.bcr.2` passes. Its one note is that `presubmit.yml` differs from 1.34.9.bcr.1's, because I copied 1.19.1.bcr.1's unchanged.
- Against this branch used as a local registry, `bazel build @c-ares//...` succeeds for 1.19.1.bcr.2 on Linux arm64 with Bazel 8.4.2 and 8.8.2, both sandboxed and with `--spawn_strategy=local`, using GCC 14 and clang 19.
- I couldn't reproduce the undeclared-inclusion error with a plain local build. 1.19.1.bcr.1 builds there too. I've only seen the error under remote execution, so I haven't verified the failure case outside that setup.

🟡 In `4.12.0.bcr.6`, `4.13.0.bcr.6`, and `4.14.0`, `cpufeatures_android` was updated to depend on a public `label_flag(name = "cpufeatures", build_setting_default = "@cpu_features//:ndk_compat")` so Android consumers can override it with `--@opencv//:cpufeatures=@androidndk//:cpufeatures`. Consider porting that `label_flag` here as well:

```suggestion
# Escape hatch for consumers that need the Android NDK's own cpufeatures instead
# of the `@cpu_features` implementation, e.g. one provided by `rules_android_ndk`:
#   --@opencv//:cpufeatures=@androidndk//:cpufeatures
label_flag(
    name = "cpufeatures",
    build_setting_default = "@cpu_features//:ndk_compat",
    visibility = ["//visibility:public"],
)

cc_library(
    name = "cpufeatures_android",
    hdrs = ["3rdparty/cpufeatures/cpu-features.h"],
    strip_include_prefix = "3rdparty/cpufeatures",
    deps = [
        ":cpufeatures",
    ],
    target_compatible_with = ["@platforms//os:android"],
)
```
